vo.en: Break a hundred-dollar bill right now.

visual.description: Close up shot of masculine hands pulling a crisp brand-new hundred dollar bill out of a sleek dark leather wallet.

vo.en: You feel a physical sting of pain, yet five twenties feel like worthless play money.

visual.description: Dynamic shot of several twenty dollar bills falling through the air against a dark background.

vo.en: This is the Denomination Effect. Your brain treats large single notes like sacred, protected treasure.

visual.description: Digital rendering of a human brain with gold neural connections pulsing with light.

vo.en: But here is the truly sinister part that drains your savings.

visual.description: Cinematic shot of a man standing in front of a glowing ATM machine at night in a city.

vo.en: Once you crack that hundred for a cheap coffee, your mental barrier completely collapses.

visual.description: Espresso dripping into a white ceramic cup from a professional machine in slow motion.

vo.en: Your brain writes off the rest as already spent, so you blow the change on junk.

visual.description: Fast-moving supermarket conveyor belt carrying snacks and candy bars past a scanner.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain hack, comment the dumbest thing you ever bought, and think twice before you

visual.description: Macro shot of heavy steel bank vault gears rotating and locking shut.
